rebuttal_or_critique: While I recognize the moderation in core inflation to 3.60%, the headline CPI at 5.10% remains uncomfortably above the 4.00% target. As an expert focused on the rural economy, the persistent food inflation of 8.30% is a critical concern, as it disproportionately impacts the purchasing power of the rural population and risks de-anchoring inflation expectations. Given the positive output gap of 0.50% and the need to ensure that the disinflationary process is durable, I believe that shifting to a neutral stance at this stage would be premature. I maintain my position that the current stance of withdrawal of accommodation is necessary to ensure that monetary policy remains firmly committed to price stability until we see a more sustained decline in headline inflation.
